pt.headline: Nazaré oferece ondas perfeitas e mar calmo — vá cedo!
pt.advice: Ondas de 1.7 m com período de 10 s e vento leve (3 kt) criam condições ideais. A água está a 16.7 °C, use fato 3/2 mm. Sem avisos costeiros na zona, mas chegue cedo para evitar a multidão.
pt.crowdTip: Chegue antes das 09h para pegar a melhor seção antes da lotação.

en.headline: Nazaré serves perfect waves and calm sea — hit the line early!
en.advice: Waves at 1.7 m with a 10 s period and light wind (3 kt) give ideal conditions. Water is 16.7 °C, wear a 3/2 mm wetsuit. No coastal warnings in the area, but arrive early to beat the crowd.
en.crowdTip: Get there before 9 am to catch the best section before it fills up.
en.moonTideLine: New moon · Spring tides · low tide 11:00

spots.name: Supertubos
spots.ptReason: Ondas boas, mas há avisos ANAV NR 12/24 e NR 2257/26 de interação marinha.
spots.enReason: Decent waves, but coastal warnings ANAV NR 12/24 and NR 2257/26 for marine interaction.

spots.name: Guincho
spots.ptReason: Condições semelhantes a Supertubos, porém com avisos ANAV NR 1445/26 e NR 1727/26.
spots.enReason: Similar conditions to Supertubos, but with ANAV NR 1445/26 and NR 1727/26 warnings.

spots.name: Nazaré
spots.ptReason: Melhor pontuação, ondas consistentes e sem avisos costeiros.
spots.enReason: Highest score, consistent waves and no coastal warnings.

spots.name: Ribeira d'Ilhas
spots.ptReason: Ótimas ondas e apenas aviso de avistamento de animais marinhos (NR 1727/26).
spots.enReason: Great waves with only a marine wildlife sighting warning (NR 1727/26).

spots.name: Coxos
spots.ptReason: Ondas de qualidade e aviso único de avistamento de animais marinhos (NR 1727/26).
spots.enReason: Quality waves and a single marine wildlife sighting warning (NR 1727/26).

spots.name: Arrifana
spots.ptReason: Boa onda, mas há aviso do Plano de Salvamento Marítimo Lagos (NR 2/22).
spots.enReason: Good wave, but there is a Lagos Maritime Rescue Plan warning (NR 2/22).

spots.name: Carcavelos
spots.ptReason: Ondas menores e múltiplos avisos de interação e segurança (NR 00/14, NR 1445/26, NR 2235/26).
spots.enReason: Smaller waves and multiple interaction and safety warnings (NR 00/14, NR 1445/26, NR 2235/26).
